recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見許多大型組織球，細胞質淡粉紅、呈顆粒或泡沫狀，其中散佈微小的點狀與小泡狀構造，對應細胞內的小型酵母菌；不過此張照片中菌體輪廓不夠清楚，需以 GMS 或 PAS 染色確認組織胞漿菌。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, granular to foamy cytoplasm
Histiocyte nuclei oval to reniform with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Faint tiny dot-like and small vacuolated intracytoplasmic structures compatible with yeast forms; individual organisms are poorly resolved in this image
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and occasional granulocytes
Scattered orange-red pigment/debris; no discrete granulomas
describe_en: At high power, the section shows numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale granular to foamy cytoplasm and vesicular oval nuclei, admixed with lymphocytes and occasional granulocytes. Within the histiocyte cytoplasm are faint tiny dot-like structures and small vacuoles corresponding to intracellular yeast forms, although individual organisms and their halos are not sharply resolved in this photograph. No well-formed granulomas or necrosis are seen. Findings are suggestive of a histiocytic infiltrate harbouring intracellular yeasts, consistent with histoplasmosis in context; special stains are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a distinct nucleus and bar-shaped kinetoplast and are GMS and PAS negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are GMS positive.
HLH histiocytes contain engulfed red cells, nucleated cells and platelets rather than tiny uniform yeasts, and fungal stains are negative.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm with striations and no discrete organisms, and PAS stains the cytoplasm diffusely rather than individual yeast walls.
MAC-laden histiocytes show striated foamy cytoplasm with innumerable acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain and no budding yeast forms on GMS.
